scripts.check: cd crates && cargo run -q --release -p verx-guard -- check
scripts.check:quick: cd crates && cargo run -q --release -p verx-guard -- check --quick
scripts.rules: cd crates && cargo run -q --release -p verx-guard -- rules
scripts.wasm: cd crates && cargo run -q --release -p verx-guard -- wasm
scripts.lint:rust: cd crates && cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy -q --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -q -p verx-sim -p verx-search -p verx-md -p verx-img --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -- -D warnings && cargo clippy -q -p verx-desktop --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun test && bun run lint:rust && bun run test:rust
